name: uberasm-gliding-parachute
title: Gliding Parachute
description:
This uberasm adds the ability to use a
parachute while Mario is in the air. By pressing the B button during
a fall, Mario will deploy a parachute that slows his descent,
allowing him to glide gently downward.

The uberasm is designed to be highly configurable, allowing
customization of color palettes, visual effects, sounds, and more.


Requested by Final Theory
This was #30 on Final Theory’s list of ASM challenges
